population: worker_type='Employee' AND employee_type='Regular' AND active_status=1 at the latest stored monthly snapshot
assumption: For this exploratory visual, the retrospective window is the six months before the latest stored snapshot. A manager-change event is a distinct employee + manager_change_date key with manager_change=1 observed no later than the snapshot.
deduplication: Repeated monthly observations of the same employee/event date count once.
publication_rule: Publish absolute counts and percentages; every displayed bucket must have n >= 30; no identifiers or individual records.
